subject: ShelfSense demo request — qualification & timeslots
content:
--- Message 1/5 ---
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@shelfsense.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a demo — signed up today

Hi Ben / Laura,

I signed up for Redwood yesterday and would love to get a quick demo to see whether it can help with our product search and discovery.

Short context: ShelfSense is building a visual + text product discovery layer for mid-market retailers. We're currently evaluating a couple of inference providers — priority is throughput (embedding-based search at scale), predictable cost, and easy on-prem/private deployment options for compliance.

Can someone from your team set up a 30–45 minute walkthrough next week? I'm in PST.

Best,
Tom Nguyen
CTO, ShelfSense
Tom Nguyen | tom@shelfsense.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--- Message 2/5 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@shelfsense.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — signed up today

Tom — thanks for signing up and the quick context. Happy to run a tailored walkthrough. Before we lock a time, two quick asks so we make the session high‑value:

1) Primary demo goal: are you focused on embeddings/rerank for product search, real‑time personalization, or both?
2) Approx traffic: monthly queries (searches) and peak QPS during business hours (ballpark is fine).
3) Timeline: when do you expect to go to production or run a pilot?
4) Data residency or compliance constraints we should be aware of (EU, on‑prem, specific certifications)?
5) Any teammates that should join from ML infra or security?

A few slots I'm proposing (all PST):
- Thu 09/09 09:00–09:45
- Thu 09/09 14:00–14:45
- Fri 09/10 11:00–11:45

If those don't work here's a short poll: https://doodle.com/poll/abc123-shelfsense-timeslots

I've attached a short "pre-demo checklist" (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) that covers the technical items we'll likely touch on (model type, latency targets, key metrics). If you can drop a rough traffic estimate and your preferred slot, we'll lock it.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.redwood.ai/ben_carter

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (one‑page stub)

--- Message 3/5 ---
From: Tom Nguyen <tom@shelfsense.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared King <j.king@shelfsense.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — signed up today

Hi Ben — thanks, quick answers below so you can shape the session:

- Primary demo goal: embeddings for semantic product search + a short discussion on reranking for improved relevance. We'll want to compare throughput/cost tradeoffs.
- Traffic: ~2,000,000 searches/month today. Average QPS ~5–10, but peak during promotions might hit ~120 QPS (short bursts).
- Timeline: pilot in Q4 2027, production H1 2028 if pilot looks good.
- Compliance: US only for now; may need on‑prem later for specific retail partners.
- Internal attendees: Jared King (infra lead) and maybe one security engineer if we get past the pilot.

I've attached a small traffic snapshot (traffic_estimates.csv) — just sample numbers.

We can do Thu 09/09 14:00 PST or Fri 09/10 11:00 PST. 14:00 would be preferable.

Thanks,
Tom
CTO, ShelfSense
Attachment: traffic_estimates.csv

--- Message 4/5 ---
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@shelfsense.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — signed up today

Tom — quick note: 14:00 PST on Thu 09/09 is free on our side and works for Ben & Jared. Will you and Jared confirm final attendees? Also, if you can flag any must‑see items (latency targets, expected payload size, sample query types) that helps the engineering demo.

I'll send calendar invite once you confirm.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

--- Message 5/5 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom@shelfsense.com>, Jared King <j.king@shelfsense.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in a demo — signed up today

Perfect — locking Thu 09/09 14:00–14:45 PST. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=meet-ical-link

Agenda (30–35 mins demo + 10–15 mins Q&A):
- Quick intro & goals (5 min)
- Architecture & latency/cost profile (Ben/Eng) (10–12 min)
- Live demo: embedding search at 2M/mo scale (demo dataset) (12–15 min)
- Next steps: pilot sizing & pricing (Ben/CS) (5 min)

Prep request (if possible before the call):
- Drop a short list of 10 sample queries (commercial/product search examples) in this thread or the shared doc.
- Any non‑negotiable latency targets (p95 / customer experience)

I'll also add a HubSpot deal note and a brief pilot proposal draft to the meeting invite. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-0733

Looking forward — talk Thursday.

Best,
Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
